summary: You can now set a time of day by which every PIM Activator activation ends.

new.title: Set a daily end time for activations
new.text: On the Client onboarding page, set a time of day by which every PIM Activator activation ends.

fixes.title: Mail send right stays in place
fixes.text: A mail send right is never removed when Exchange does not report a scope's filter.

fixes.title: Managed tenants set up mail themselves
fixes.text: A managed tenant build no longer sets up the mail sender. Your Exchange administrator does it under Get Started > Mail sender.

fixes.title: Hybrid worker removal keeps shared servers
fixes.text: Removing the hybrid worker keeps the server when another product is registered on it, or when that cannot be checked.
